newsitem.title: FINLAND: IVO HAS 15 PCT OF FIM 5.5 BLN THAI POWER PLANT.
newsitem.headline: IVO HAS 15 PCT OF FIM 5.5 BLN THAI POWER PLANT.

text.p: Finnish state-controlled power group Imatran Voima Oy (IVO) said in a statement on Thursday it would own 15 percent of a 5.5 billion markka project to build a 1,400 megawatt (MW) coal-fuelled power plant in Thailand.
IVO's associated company in Thailand was part of a consortium, which won the contract for the Hin Krut power plant some 300 km south of Bangkok, IVO said.
"The Hin Krut project will be financed mainly on the Thai and international venture capital markets," it said, adding Finnish financiers would also be asked for offers.
Construction work would start in September 1997, and electricity deliveries are due to begin in 2001.
"IVO's ownership of the project is 15 percent. In addition, IVO will be responsible for operating the coming coal power plant and for maintenance," it said.
